data.title: 冬马和纱 · 翻页的间隙
data.description: 离开前，和纱站在琴凳旁，把散落的谱纸对齐收进文件夹。
data.action: standing beside the piano and gathering sheet music into a folder
data.promptProse: Gathering loose, ink-annotated sheets of music into a black leather portfolio on the piano bench, Kazusa looks up sharply toward the doorway as if interrupted. The quiet music room is bathed in the cool silver twilight of early winter, with frost feathering the corners of the tall windows and a discarded woolen scarf draped over a chair.
